hook: One forty-seven, on a Sunday morning. Someone becomes an admin. Nobody asked for it.
stat1: On average, it takes two hundred and forty-one days to identify and contain a breach.
stat2: And the average breach costs four point four four million dollars.
intro: Here is how Mova iO reverses an unapproved admin grant, in six minutes, at two in the morning.
s1: A Microsoft Sentinel analytics rule fires in the Defender portal: a privileged role was assigned outside Privileged Identity Management.
s2: The Entra audit log shows the detail. An admin account gave a contractor permanent Privileged Role Administrator rights, the role that can grant every other role.
s3: Mova iO checks what a person would check. There's no approved change in ServiceNow. The contractor's contract ended two weeks ago. The admin is on leave. And his sign-in came from a rented server with an anomalous token. The new role hasn't been used yet.
s4: The identity on-call gets an urgent card in Teams, with everything she needs to decide. She approves from her phone.
s5: In Copilot Studio, every step is a tool call you can inspect: the change search, the contract check, the calendar, the sign-in risk, the approval, and every containment action.
s6: In P I M, the assignment is gone. The contractor account is disabled, both accounts' sessions are revoked, and the attacker's next attempt is blocked.
s7: The security incident in ServiceNow records it all, with follow-ups for Monday: a review of every permanent admin role, and fourteen leftover contractor accounts to remove.
close: Granted at one forty-seven. Reversed at one fifty-three. A human decided, from their phone, in two minutes.
tag: Privilege escalation, reversed by Mova iO agents. With people in control.
end: Movate. Your applied A I partner.
